import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.Reader;

public class Scoping {
    private int rate = 1;
    private int total;

    void shadow(int rate) {
        int total = rate + this.rate;
        this.total = total;
        {
            int inner = total;
            total = inner + 1;
        }
        for (int i = 0, j = 1; i < j; i++) {
            total += i;
        }
        for (String item : names()) {
            total += item.length();
        }
    }

    int read(Reader source) throws IOException {
        try (Reader r = source; Reader q = r) {
            return q.read();
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw e;
        } finally {
            total = 0;
        }
    }

    String[] names() { return new String[0]; }
}
